Can we just use `SortedSetDocValues` here directly instead of using an additional layer of abstraction? 

For example in `DocValuesSortedKeyedValues` we directly sorted set doc values instead of `DocValuesFieldValues` as an intermediate interface.
Do we need the `DocValuesFieldValues` interface at all? It is either no value or uses `SortedSetDocValues`. Maybe we always use `SortedSetDocValues` directly and in case of no value it is null?

I was actually looking at that too. I believe we can't directly use `SortedSetDocValues` because when there is no doc values, it contains an empty singleton which we don't expect. We could just set it to null indeed.

So `FlattenedFieldDocValuesLoader` also tracks if current document has doc values and i think inlining all this logic into `FlattenedSortedSetDocValuesSyntheticFieldLoader` reduces readability quite a bit. I'll keep this as is.
